description: On the bed in front of you there’s a small stack of chunky building blocks in blue, yellow, green, white, and red. The left hand holds the block stack steady while the right hand lifts off the red piece and sets it down to the right, then the right hand removes the white piece and places it in front; the blocks are further separated as the left hand keeps the blue base in hand while the right hand moves the remaining colored pieces into a loose spread on the bed.
